title: FeatureSnapshot / V60
description: FROZEN_INTEGRATION.md §4 + ADAPTIVE_REDTEAM_RUNTIME.md §4.4. Total, deterministic, pure mapping to V60. Coordinate groups: 0-11 response behavior, 12-21 grading, 22-31 runtime/trace, 32-41 probe/strategy, 42-51 campaign history, 52-59 provenance/quality. featureView distinguishes OBSERVATION (describes evidence already obtained, used for training labels) from CANDIDATE (describes a possible next RunStep, used for online scoring) — a model admitted for CANDIDATE must reject an OBSERVATION snapshot even at matching dimensionality (ADAPTIVE_REDTEAM_RUNTIME.md §4.4, redteam.feature/observation-and-candidate-views-are-not-interchangeable).

V60.description: Exactly 60 finite structured features. Never derived from frozen_embed(payload) or raw payload bytes — FeatureCompiler §4.3 forbidden inputs. A coordinate this compiler has no real signal for yet is set to the missing-value sentinel (see src/features/missing.ts), never guessed.

sourceObservationId.description: Required (non-null) when featureView=OBSERVATION; must be null when featureView=CANDIDATE — a candidate has no source Observation, it has not been executed yet.

candidateProbeId.description: Required (non-null) when featureView=CANDIDATE; must be null when featureView=OBSERVATION.

candidateTargetId.description: Required (non-null) when featureView=CANDIDATE; must be null when featureView=OBSERVATION. A candidate's identity is the (target, probe) pair, not the probe alone — see history-view.ts's targetProbeKey().
